name: isa-continuation
description: ISA gate, Q2: with an open ISA, does the new message continue its task or start a new one? (SPEC-v2 § 12.3)

new_task.instructions: Does the user's new message start a different task with its own end state, rather than continue the open one (refine it, answer a question about it, approve the next step, report on it, add to it)?

resumes.instructions: If it is a different task, will the user likely come back to the open task afterwards (a side task, an interruption) rather than leave it for good?
